description: CapMeta builder tool over the server's in-memory draft registry (no Linode API call). Pins the refusals both languages answer as tool results, an absent name and a clone source that resolves to no profile, plus the one success a single call can reach: creating a draft from nothing. Every other builder success needs a draft the previous call left behind, and each case runs against a fresh server, so those stay with the in-package seam tests.

cases.name: refuses a clone source that resolves to nothing
creates a draft and answers its empty state
